allowed.panel: Seconds since the last failure, by job and phase
allowed.reason: Empty until a host job fails or is interrupted; a healthy chain run has no failure.

allowed.panel: Seconds since the last heartbeat of running jobs
allowed.reason: Empty while no host job runs, which is the state once the chain run has finished.

allowed.panel: Memory of running jobs
allowed.reason: Empty while no host job runs.

allowed.panel: Scratch peak of running jobs so far
allowed.reason: Empty while no host job runs.

allowed.panel: HAI types with no Production baseline
allowed.reason: Empty while every HAI type has a Production model.

allowed.panel: Result of the latest release, by feature set
allowed.reason: Empty until a held online load is released; a chain without a held load never releases.

allowed.panel: Spark tasks and stages running now
allowed.reason: Empty while the bronze load does not run, which is the state once the chain run has finished.

allowed.panel: Tasks stopped in the last hour, by service and stop code
allowed.reason: Empty while no service task stopped in the last hour.

allowed.panel: Executed promotions and rollbacks, by HAI type
allowed.reason: Empty until a promotion or rollback is executed.

allowed.panel: Owner notice verdict, by HAI type
allowed.reason: Empty until a research chain sends its first owner notice.

allowed.panel: Canary decision, by HAI type
allowed.reason: Empty until a research chain runs its canary phase.

allowed.panel: Production version at research, by HAI type
allowed.reason: Empty for a type with no Production model yet.

allowed.panel: Unfinished units, by data source
allowed.reason: Empty while no unit of the latest publisher run failed or was refused.

allowed.panel: Age of the last success, by data source

allowed.reason: Empty until a layer job publishes with the publish counts.

allowed.panel: Tables changed and tables empty, by layer
allowed.reason: Empty until a layer job publishes with the publish counts.

allowed.panel: Age of the newest publish, by layer
allowed.reason: Empty until a layer job publishes with the publish counts.

allowed.panel: Lineage events not delivered in the last 15 minutes

allowed.reason: Empty until the launcher counts a launch after the launch counts are deployed, and empty while no launch was refused.
